What is meant by the term tonus, or tone?

options.A: Tonus refers to the electrical activity in the brain during relaxation.
options.B: Tonus refers to the maximum force a muscle can exert in a single effort.
options.C: Tonus refers to the flexibility and range of motion in joints and muscles.
options.D: Tonus refers to the state of complete relaxation in skeletal muscles.
options.E: Tonus refers to the involuntary contraction of smooth muscles in the digestive tract.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Tonus refers to the electrical activity in the brain during relaxation.

questions.stem_text:
During the courtship of the common tern, the male presents afish to another tern. Account
for this behavior and discuss whycourtship in general may benecesaryfor reproduction.

options.A: Courtship is primarily for entertainment purposes among terns
options.B: Courtship is not necessary for reproduction
options.C: Courtship is a way to show dominance
options.D: Courtship is a random behavior with no impact on reproduction
options.E: Courtship is necessary for physical transformation required for reproduction

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Courtship is primarily for entertainment purposes among terns

questions.stem_text:
Why would you not expect conjugation among a group of paramecia that had descended from a
single individual through repeated fission?

options.A: conjugation results in no genetic diversity
options.B: conjugation requires more than two organisms
options.C: all individuals are identical genetically, and conjugation could not occur
options.D: repeated fission in paramecia results in sterile offspring that cannot conjugate
options.E: the group of paramecia lacks the cellular structures necessary for conjugation

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - all individuals are identical genetically, and conjugation could not occur
